source:
# Wright engineering workflow source
# Stable names identify engineering items, steps, connection points, and routes.
# Versions, history, integrity digests, canvas layout, and run state are managed by Wright.
# Optional groups are shown only when they improve a larger or explicitly grouped workflow.

workflow test
  name: "Test"
  purpose: "Prepared input fixture"
  discipline: engineering
  reviewed_ai_suggestions: false
end

input brief
  name: "Brief"
  purpose: "Prepared input"
  step_type: work
  group: null
  provided_by: engineer
  inputs: []
  outputs: [{"description":"Document","item":null,"key":"brief_out","kind":"engineering_document","name":"brief_out","quantity":"one","required":false}]
  instructions: "Use exact input"
  settings: {"interaction_input":{"default":"Compare a and b after editing.","required":true,"value_schema":{"minLength":2,"type":"string"},"version":1}}
  tool: null
  reusable_step: null
end

task first
  name: "First"
  purpose: "Use exact input"
  step_type: work
  group: null
  performed_by: ai_assisted
  inputs: [{"description":"Document","item":null,"key":"first_in","kind":"engineering_document","name":"first_in","quantity":"one","required":true}]
  outputs: [{"description":"Document","item":null,"key":"first_out","kind":"engineering_document","name":"first_out","quantity":"one","required":false}]
  prompt: "Prepare a result"
  settings: {"output_filename":"first.txt","output_format":"text","save_output":true}
  tool: null
  reusable_step: null
end

task choice
  name: "Select comparison"
  purpose: "Declared input"
  step_type: work
  group: null
  performed_by: engineer
  inputs: [{"description":"Document","item":null,"key":"choice_evidence","kind":"engineering_document","name":"choice_evidence","quantity":"one","required":true}]
  outputs: [{"description":"Document","item":null,"key":"choice_response","kind":"structured_result","name":"choice_response","quantity":"one","required":true}]
  instructions: "Review both measured comparison outputs before selecting."
  settings: {"authoring_template":"human-input","human_interaction":{"instructions":"Review both measured comparison outputs before selecting.","kind":"input","output_port":"choice_response","response_schema":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"selection":{"enum":["a","b","c"],"type":"string"}},"required":["selection"],"type":"object"},"version":1}}
  tool: null
  reusable_step: null
end

task second
  name: "Use selection"
  purpose: "Use declared response"
  step_type: work
  group: null
  performed_by: ai_assisted
  inputs: [{"description":"Document","item":null,"key":"second_input","kind":"structured_result","name":"second_input","quantity":"one","required":true}]
  outputs: [{"description":"Document","item":null,"key":"second_output","kind":"engineering_document","name":"second_output","quantity":"one","required":false}]
  prompt: "Use the supplied selection."
  settings: {"output_filename":"second.txt","output_format":"text"}
  tool: null
  reusable_step: null
end

connection supplied
  type: item
  from: "brief.brief_out"
  to: "first.first_in"
  label: "Input"
  when: null
end

connection evidence
  type: item
  from: "first.first_out"
  to: "choice.choice_evidence"
  label: "Declared dependency"
  when: null
end

connection response
  type: item
  from: "choice.choice_response"
  to: "second.second_input"
  label: "Declared dependency"
  when: null
end
